bio: Printer who learnt type-making from Thomas Graham and cut Marathi and Gujarati types, casting his own Devanagari font around 1846 at his press in Bombay.

sources.title: Typography of Devanagari, Volume One, pp. 297, 307–308 (Bapurao S. Naik)
sources.publisher: Directorate of Languages, Government of Maharashtra

sources.title: Devanagari: the makings of a national character - Typotheque
